entities.summary: Josefina Guerrero was a Filipino spy during World War II. Guerrero had leprosy and was an unsuspicious and effective surveillance asset for American allied forces. In 1948, she made history as the first foreign national with leprosy to receive a U.S. visa, and her admission to the Carville Leprosarium was accompanied by significant media attention.
